jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Crossfoot, an AI-native accounting agent platform.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Crossfoot, an AI-native accounting agent platform. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Crossfoot is agentic accounting for small-to-mid CPA firms; a segment where accountant shortages are structural, client intake is capped by production headcount, and the manual close and tax prep workflow consumes the majority of senior staff capacity. Crossfoot connects to the tools firms already use (QuickBooks Online, Xero, Drake) and delivers finished work products ready for partner review, without requiring system migration or enterprise-scale implementation.

Market Context

  • We didn't just build a thesis; we validated it directly with the market. We've spoken with CPA firm managing partners, CAS leads, and tax preparers. The key insights:
  • The "why now" is structural, not hype: the profession lost 300,000+ professionals from 2020–2024, and the replacement pipeline has shrunk ~33% in a decade. Firms now cap new-client intake by production headcount rather than demand. They turn away winnable work they can't staff. Meanwhile, CAS (advisory) revenue is projected to reach 30% of the firm's revenue by 2026.
  • Senior accountants spend 40%+ of their time on document intake and workbook compilation — $90K staff doing $20/hour data entry — while month-end close runs 10–15 business days on a pure manual process.
  • Early AI adopters in accounting already earn 39% more revenue per employee. The gap between firms that move and firms that don't is compounding now.
  • We are targeting a large, fragmented, structurally underserved market. The total addressable market is an estimated $1.5B+ across 87,000+ US accounting firms, with a focused beachhead SAM of $400M+ (small/mid firms).

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, size-tiered pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with managing partners, CAS leads, and outsourced-accounting/BPO operators at small-to-mid CPA firms, convert them to paid engagements, and build the referral-led go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Deep accounting domain expertise, with hands-on experience managing close processes, tax preparation, workpapers, and client accounting services within CPA firms.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
We are Hiring!

We have an exciting new opportunity at Scope for a Supplier Quality Manager to join our team!

We are looking for people who can connect their own personal vision and values into some of what we do at Scope.

Our vision as a company is to become a leading force in Eyecare, with people at our core.

Please read below the full job description for the role and if this is something that you would be interested in, please click apply and a member of the Scope team will be in touch regarding your application.

Supplier Quality Manager

Working within the Quality Department, the Supplier Quality Manager is responsible for supplier-facing processes to ensure that SCOPE’s suppliers are properly qualified and managed.

This is a remote position requiring regular global travel. The post holder should be comfortable travelling internationally for up to 50% of their time.

Please note, we are open to candidates located in the UK, IRL and the USA.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the compliant and efficient operation of the following systems / processes:

o Supplier Qualification

o Supplier Management

o Supplier Auditing

o Development of Quality Technical Agreements with suppliers and customers

o Supplier Corrective Actions (SCAR)

· Support the wider Quality function to ensure compliant and efficient operation of wider QMS systems and processes.

· Promote a culture of continual improvement within the team and wider company by:

o Championing root cause analysis and use of appropriate risk management tools throughout all activities.

o Coaching others to help them understand how their day-to-day activities relate to the Quality Policy and Quality Objectives.

o Ensuring that all processes and working practices within your area of responsibility are constantly reviewed and any compliance or efficiency improvements are implemented in a timely fashion proportional to the risks identified.

o Ensure all procedures relating to the systems you are responsible for are kept up-to-date and reflect both internal and external best practices.

· Support the wider Quality function by:

o Ensuring adherence to Health and Safety, Good Manufacturing Practice and other relevant guidelines and legal obligations.

o Supporting team members to develop their skills and functional expertise.

· Ensure delivery of activities within your area of responsibility to ensure customer and business targets are met.

· Act as a peer reviewer to check and approve work generated within your own and the wider quality team.

o Ensure any corrections or errors are fed back to the author of the work in a constructive manner with a view to preventing recurrence.

· Act as a functional trainer within the wider team.

Key Performance Indicators

· All Quality Objectives are consistently met for all processes and systems within your area of responsibility,

o Rapid and appropriate corrective actions taken to address any drift from Quality Objective targets,

o Evidence of evolution of processes to meet current best practice and increase efficiency.

· No avoidable or repeat incidents / deviations associated with processes and systems within your area of responsibility.

· Processes are operated to meet business and customer expectations and targets.

· Performance and contribution are regularly reviewed, with appropriate action taken to recognise good performance and correct areas requiring development.

Qualifications

Essential:

  • Experience of carrying out supplier audits in at least one regulated industry (e.g. medicines or medical devices. Cosmetics and/or food supplement auditing may also be considered with extensive experience)

Desirable:

  • Experience of carrying out supplier audits in multiple regulated industries (e.g. medicines, medical devices, cosmetics, food supplements),
  • Experience of delivering and managing Critical/Major audit findings,
  • Experience of negotiating Quality Technical Agreements or similar contractual documents with third parties,
  • Experience of quality supplier liaison/management.

Specific Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Key Capabilities

  • Excellent attention to detail,
  • Good analytical and problem-solving abilities,
  • Detailed knowledge of root cause analysis and risk management tools and their application,
  • Good understanding of applicable regulations, standards and best practices,
  • Good communication, interpersonal and influencing skills,
  • Good numerical skills and the ability to handle and analyse data,
  • Sound knowledge of data analysis tools (e.g. Excel, Minitab),
  • The ability to present complex information (both internally and externally) to diverse audiences and levels of understanding,
  • Planning and project management skills,
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time.

jobs.description:
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.

8x8 is seeking a Product Manager to own two of the most consequential domains in our Finance Technology organization: ERP, Billing & Core Finance Platforms and Revenue & Monetization Platforms. This is not a traditional enterprise IT PM role. You will be the product conscience of systems that directly govern how 8x8 prices, bills, recognizes revenue, and closes its books.

You will sit at the intersection of Finance, Engineering, and go-to-market — translating complex monetization requirements into system architecture decisions, driving billing accuracy, and enabling the organization to move faster on pricing changes without sacrificing revenue integrity. You will work closely with the Director of Finance Technology and partner daily with functional leads across ERP, billing, RevRec, and integrations.

What You'll Own

ERP, Billing & Core Finance

Own the product roadmap for 8x8's billing engine (Logisense), order-to-cash workflows, and ERP systems (Netsuite GL/AP/AR)
Drive billing accuracy initiatives — reduce invoice defect rate, credit memo volume, and billing reruns through structured product improvements
Partner with the Billing/O2C functional specialist and ERP functional analyst to translate Finance requirements into prioritized engineering backlog
Define and track KPIs: invoice defect rate, ERP uptime, days-to-close trend, % automated journal entries, cash application automation

Revenue & Monetization Platforms

Own the product roadmap for pricing architecture, subscription lifecycle logic, and RevRec systems
Drive monetization agility — reduce time to launch new pricing models and enable pricing changes without external consultants
Ensure revenue integrity across the billing-to-RevRec pipeline, targeting zero restatement incidents and minimizing billing-to-RevRec variance
Support tax automation extension and evaluate pricing system requirements for potential M&A integration scenarios
Define and track KPIs: time to launch new pricing models, RevRec restatement incidents, billing-to-RevRec variance rate, post-release defect rate

What We're Looking For
Required Experience
6+ years in product management, with at least 3 years owning enterprise finance systems — ERP, billing engines, or revenue recognition platforms in a SaaS company
Hands-on experience with Netsuite (GL/AP/AR) or equivalent ERP, and a billing engine (Logisense, Zuora, or similar) — able to speak to configuration tradeoffs, not just outcomes
Fluency in order-to-cash and lead-to-cash flows — you can diagram the journey from a quote in Salesforce to a posted journal entry in the ERP without prompting
Working knowledge of ASC 606 and how RevRec system configuration drives compliance — you understand allocation logic, performance obligations, and restatement risk
Track record of driving billing accuracy and close efficiency improvements through system change, not just process workarounds
Experience partnering directly with Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations stakeholders — you speak their language and can translate business constraints into engineering requirements

Strongly Preferred
Experience with SFDC CPQ or equivalent quoting/pricing configuration
Familiarity with tax integration systems (Avalara, Vertex) and how configuration changes propagate through billing and ERP
Experience working in a hybrid matrix org model with matrixed engineering resources

Key Competencies

Systems Thinking

Revenue Integrity

Stakeholder Management

Monetization Architecture
Backlog Discipline
ERP Configuration Literacy
M&A Readiness
Data-Driven Prioritization

Cross-functional Influence

The Team You'll Work With
You'll join Finance Technology organization — a lean, high-accountability team of functional domain leads, billing and ERP specialists, and matrixed engineering across application, integration, data, and AI disciplines. The team is mid-transformation: several major platform migrations are underway (Logisense, CPAAS billing, Paymentus/Gaviti interface), and the roadmap over the next 12 months is ambitious.

This role is a critical hire. You will bring product rigor to a domain that has historically been led by strong functional operators — and you will raise the bar on roadmap predictability, delivery accountability, and executive stakeholder communication.

Why This Role
Greenfield opportunity to introduce modern product management practice into a finance systems org that is ready for it
Active, high-stakes roadmap — you won't be maintaining a stable system; you'll be building and migrating critical infrastructure
Collaborative org model with clear domain accountability and strong engineering partners
Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits

Це можливість працювати над AI SEO як основною спеціалізацією, розвивати експертизу в напрямі, попит на який зростає, та бачити безпосередній результат своєї роботи.


Що ви будете робити:

  • Аналізувати, як бренд відображається у ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini та Google AI Overviews.

  • Аналізувати брендову видачу в Google, Bing, Brave та знаходити точки для покращення.

  • Будувати активи під результат, сателіти, PBN, сторінки, посилання, потрібні сайти.

  • Працювати над покращенням AI Visibility брендів.

  • Вимірювати appearance rate до і після, тримати результат відтворюваним.

  • Співпрацювати із засновником і підрядниками для реалізації SEO-стратегії.

Очікуємо що ви:

  • Маєте 1–2 роки практичного досвіду в SEO, лінкбілдингу та побудові сіток сайтів (PBN/сателітів), який можете підтвердити власними кейсами.

  • Володієте технічним SEO та повністю самостійно працюєте з доменами, хостингом, CMS і запуском сайтів без залучення розробника.

  • Маєте досвід або готові швидко зануритися в brand probing в AI-пошукових системах, аналіз SERP і брендової видачі, а також вимірювання appearance rate.

  • Використовуєте AI-інструменти (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini тощо) для SEO-досліджень, автоматизації та оптимізації робочих процесів.

  • Готові працювати з підходами, що виходять за межі класичного white-hat SEO, та відкриті до роботи в ніші iGaming.

  • Володієте англійською мовою на рівні B1+.

  • Досвід роботи в iGaming буде перевагою.

Що пропонуємо ми:

  • Свободу в прийнятті рішень та відсутність бюрократії.

  • Доступ до ресурсів.

  • Гідну оплату праці та прозору бонусну систему.

  • Гнучкий і віддалений формат роботи.

  • Курси англійської мови.

  • Тімбілдінги та корпоративні заходи.

  • Забезпечення автономності роботи. Надаємо ресурси, завдяки яким блекаути не завадять твоїй роботі.

  • Оплачувані відпустки та лікарняні.

Ми вважаємо нашою соціальною відповідальністю робити внесок у розвиток суспільства через допомогу тваринам.

Наш проєкт Playduck Charity активно займається підтримкою ініціатив, які спрямовані на допомогу безхатнім тваринам. Сьогодні, наша команда допомагає створювати кращі умови для проживання в 30 притулках по всій Україні.
Від самого початку своєї діяльності, ми впроваджуємо соціальні ініціативи, що націлені на підтримку та поліпшення життя тих, хто цього найбільше потребує.

jobs.description:
SAP MM Consultant – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP MM Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$190,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP MM Consultant to lead the implementation, enhancement, and support of enterprise SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions supporting global procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, and supply chain initiatives. This role focuses on delivering scalable SAP S/4HANA MM solutions that streamline Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, vendor management, material planning, and inventory optimization across enterprise environments.
You will work closely with procurement teams, supply chain leaders, warehouse operations, finance stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, and technical teams to design and configure SAP MM solutions that improve procurement efficiency, inventory visibility, and operational performance. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in SAP MM configuration, cross-functional integration, and SAP S/4HANA transformation projects while maintaining a strong understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay business processes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze business requirements and design scalable SAP MM solutions supporting procurement and supply chain operations.
  • Configure SAP Materials Management components including Purchasing, Inventory Management, Material Master, Vendor Master, Valuation, and Invoice Verification.
  • Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement projects across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Configure organizational structures including plants, storage locations, purchasing organizations, purchasing groups, valuation areas, and company codes.
  • Configure material types, material groups, account determination, release strategies, valuation classes, and movement types.
  • Design and configure procurement processes including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, scheduling agreements, RFQs, and source determination.
  • Configure inventory management processes including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, physical inventory, and cycle counting.
  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to prepare Functional Specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, workflows, BADIs, User Exits, IDOCs, and forms.
  • Integrate SAP MM with SD, PP, FI/CO, WM, EWM, QM, PM, and Ariba modules.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration projects, system upgrades, testing, cutover activities, and post-go-live support.
  • Develop functional documentation including Business Process Documents (BPDs), Functional Specifications, Configuration Documents, and Test Scripts.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide ongoing application support.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, solution design workshops, architecture reviews, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills
  • Seven or more years of hands-on SAP MM consulting experience supporting enterprise SAP implementations.
  • Strong expertise in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Materials Management configuration.
  • Extensive knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring Purchasing, Inventory Management, Invoice Verification, Material Master, Vendor Master, and Procurement processes.
  • Strong experience configuring material types, purchasing document types, release procedures, movement types, valuation classes, account determination, and pricing procedures.
  • Experience configuring procurement processes including RFQs, Contracts, Scheduling Agreements, Purchase Orders, and Vendor Evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, warehouse operations, stock transfers, physical inventory, cycle counting, and inventory valuation.
  • Experience integrating SAP MM with FI/CO, SD, PP, QM, WM, EWM, PM, and Ariba.
  • Experience preparing Functional Specifications for ABAP developments including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows (RICEFW).
  • Familiarity with IDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, APIs, EDI, and middleware integration technologies.
  • Experience supporting integrations with supplier portals, procurement platforms, warehouse management systems, and third-party logistics providers.
  • Experience with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, SAP GUI, and SAP Fiori.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and business process optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum or SAP Activate implementation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in multiple full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration projects.
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori Apps, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and SAP Integration Suite.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, SAP Supplier Lifecycle Management (SLM), and SAP Business Network.
  • Knowledge of SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Warehouse Management (WM), and Transportation Management (TM).
  • Experience supporting global procurement and supply chain organizations.
  • Familiarity with Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Demand Planning, and Supply Chain Planning processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP with Coupa, Jaggaer, Salesforce, MuleSoft, Boomi, or other enterprise applications.
  • SAP Certified Application Associate or SAP Certified Professional certification in SAP MM or SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, retail, or consumer goods industries.
  • Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), procurement reporting, and operational analytics is a plus.

Project Environment
You will be joining a global SAP transformation program responsible for modernizing procurement, inventory, and supply chain operations across multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • SAP S/4HANA Greenfield and Brownfield implementation projects
  • Enterprise Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process transformation
  • Global procurement standardization and vendor management optimization
  • SAP Ariba and supplier collaboration platform integration
  • Warehouse Management (WM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) modernization
  • Inventory optimization and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) enhancements
  • SAP Fiori application rollout for procurement and warehouse users
  • Enterprise workflow automation for purchasing approvals
  • Cloud-based SAP integrations using SAP BTP and Integration Suite
This is a hands-on functional consulting role where you will contribute to solution architecture, SAP MM configuration, procurement process optimization, system integration, testing, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise supply chain platforms.

Consultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead

United Kingdom (Remote)

Reporting to:Clinical Director for ASD, CYP and Old Age

Contract Type:﻿Permanent/ Part time - 32 hours per week (0.8FTE)

Location:Home-based/various UK meeting locations as required

Closing Date for applications:Tuesday 11th August 2026*

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

The Consultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead plays a pivotal role within Psychiatry UK, providing expert clinical leadership to one of the UK's leading independent digital mental health providers. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Consultant Child & Adolescent Psychiatrist to shape the future of Children and Young People (CYP) services, influence clinical strategy, and drive innovation in the delivery of high-quality, patient-centred care.

Working in close partnership with the Clinical Director, the Clinical Lead will provide visible and credible clinical leadership, champion excellence in clinical governance, and support the continued growth and development of our multidisciplinary teams. The postholder will play a key role in ensuring safe, effective, evidence-based care while driving continuous quality improvement, enhancing patient outcomes, and supporting the strategic objectives of the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to influence service development at a national level while maintaining a strong focus on clinical quality, patient safety, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with clinical and operational leaders to ensure the continued delivery of innovative, accessible, and high-quality services for children and young people across the UK.

This is a home-based role (applicants must reside in the UK), offering genuine flexibility and work-life balance, although occasional travel may be required for face-to-face meetings at various locations within the UK.

As ourConsultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead, you will:

  • Provide clinical leadership for Psychiatry UK's Children and Young People (CYP) services, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective, evidence-based care and excellent patient outcomes.

  • Lead and support the multidisciplinary clinical team by providing expert clinical guidance, promoting best practice, and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.

  • Work in partnership with the Clinical Director and operational leaders to shape and develop CYP services, driving innovation, service transformation, and continuous quality improvement across the organisation.

  • Oversee clinical governance, ensuring services meet CQC, safeguarding, and regulatory standards while maintaining the highest levels of clinical quality and patient safety.

  • Monitor clinical performance, patient outcomes, and service quality, using data, audit findings, and patient feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and enhance clinical effectiveness.

  • Support the recruitment, induction, supervision, mentoring, and professional development of clinicians, helping to build a skilled, engaged, and resilient workforce.

  • Chair and contribute to multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings, providing clinical oversight and supporting effective decision-making across the service.

  • Work collaboratively with operational colleagues to optimise clinical capacity, workforce planning, and patient pathways, ensuring timely access to high-quality care for children and young people.

  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, supporting integrated working, service development, and the continued growth of Psychiatry UK's CYP services.

To succeed as ourConsultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead, you will be:

An experienced and inspirational Consultant Child & Adolescent Psychiatrist with a passion for clinical leadership, service improvement, and delivering exceptional patient care. You will be a credible and supportive leader, capable of inspiring multidisciplinary teams while building collaborative relationships across the organisation and with external partners.

You will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, demonstrate sound clinical judgement, and be confident making decisions within complex clinical environments. You will thrive in a dynamic and evolving healthcare setting, bringing a strategic mindset, strong organisational skills, and a commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and high-quality patient-centred care.

Essential Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Medical degree with postgraduate qualification (MRCPsych or equivalent).

  • Full GMC registration with a licence to practise and inclusion on the GMC Specialist Register for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry.

  • Extensive Consultant-level clinical experience in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry.

  • Demonstrable experience providing clinical leadership within a complex healthcare environment.

  • Experience leading, supervising, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary clinical teams.

  • Evidence of participation in clinical audit, quality improvement, and service development initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of clinical governance, safeguarding, patient safety, and compliance with relevant regulatory standards.

  • Extensive knowledge of evidence-based assessment and treatment approaches for ADHD, Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), and wider child and young people's mental health conditions.

Desirable Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Experience delivering clinical education, teaching, or mentoring.

  • Research experience, including publications or presentations relating to mental health or Children and Young People (CYP).

  • Senior management qualification (e.g. MBA or equivalent).

  • Experience leading service development, transformation, or innovation projects within healthcare.

  • Experience of budget management and resource planning within clinical services.

  • Knowledge of epidemiology, healthcare evaluation, and statistical analysis relevant to mental health services.

  • Experience using clinical data and analytics to drive performance improvement and service delivery.

  • Project and change management experience, including supporting organisational development and workforce engagement.

  • Experience developing and implementing clinical risk management and safeguarding frameworks.

  • Strong IT skills, including experience using electronic health records, clinical databases, and reporting systems.

  • Commercial awareness with the ability to contribute to the strategic growth and development of Psychiatry UK's CYP services.

Psychiatry UK: Supporting You

We want you to enjoy your work while feeling healthy, happy, and appreciated. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed with you in mind. You’ll have access to a range of wellbeing perks, including a Health Cash Plan, Well Hub Subscription, access to an Employee Assistance Programme, Annual Volunteering Day, Enhanced Sickness and Family Leave pay, Length of Service Bonus, Work from Home allowance and Pension options.

At Psychiatry UK, we care about what matters to you.

Recruitment Process

﻿At Psychiatry UK, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Our process includes:

·Application

·Profile review

If at any point you require any reasonable adjustments —such as additional time, assistive technology, or an alternative format for materials—please let us know. We are happy to accommodate your needs to ensure you have a fair and comfortable experience.

  • Support final electronic approval processes and ensure compliance with established procedures, systems, and standard operating procedures

  • Collaborate effectively within an integrated team environment and participate in ongoing project governance, feedback, and alignment activities

Candidate Profile

  • Strong medical writing, project coordination, and document management capabilities

  • The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly with a variety of stakeholders

  • A quality focused mindset and strong attention to detail

Under the supervision of the Head of FoE Programme,theProject Manager will lead Internews International’s implementation of a 4-year EC funded programme aimedtostrengthenindependent media and content creators in the MENA region through targeted financial support, capacity building, and digital innovation.This role will provide project management and fiscal oversight of the project, and leads on strategy development, design, and implementation; tracking deliverables; leading donor reporting; working closely with the rest of the FoE team; and engaging business management staff as needed.

Project Leadership & Management

  • Lead day-to-day management of Internews-led project activities, ensuring delivery against agreed outputs, timelines and budget.
  • Develop and maintain workplans, budgets and risk registers, adjusting as needed to the MENA operating context.
  • Directly manage the project staff, providing supervision, support and performance management.
  • Oversee sub-grants, donor reporting and coordinate with MEL colleagues to ensure cross-functional delivery.
  • Serve as Internews' primary point of coordination with the consortium lead applicant, aligning workplans, donor reporting and MEL frameworks.

Regional Leadership, Strategy & Donor Engagement

  • Act as a senior programmatic voice for Internews' MENA media and information portfolio, contributing to regional strategy development.
  • Represent Internews with donors, EU Delegations, and regional stakeholders on media, information, and digital rights issues.
  • Lead or contribute to proposal development and new business efforts for MENA media and digital programming, including budget and narrative input.
  • Build and maintain relationships with regional media networks, civil society, and digital rights actors.
  • Contribute regional analysis and positioning to inform Internews' wider MENA strategy and donor relationships.

Technical Expertise

  • Bring strong understanding of digital safety, digital transformation, and audience/platform optimisation to inform the design and quality of project activities.
  • Provide credible technical judgement on digital safety and digital transformation questions arising from programme implementation.
  • Keep abreast of emerging digital threats, tools, and practices relevant to independent media and content creators in MENA.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required

Preferred

  • Experience supporting content creator/influencer engagement programmes.
  • Experience coordinating with consortium/co-applicant partners on joint donor-funded actions.
  • Prior experience with digital security/safety and other capacity-building support models.

jobs.excerpt: Material Bank is the world’s largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry.
jobs.description:
Material Bank is the world’s largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

Material Bank is seeking a Staff Applied Scientist to drive building search and recommendations from the ground up. We are the largest marketplace for architecture and design professionals, and we are building a discovery platform that helps them find materials across hundreds of brands and surfaces intelligent recommendations as they explore. Search and recommendations are how that discovery happens. The surface is wide open, the right techniques for our domain are still unsettled, and the person in this role is the one who figures them out and builds them.

This is a hands-on research role. You will not hand formulas to an engineering team and walk away. You will explore the data, form the hypothesis, prototype the approach, and prove it works, then partner with engineering to take it to production.

What you'll do

  • Improve search retrieval and ranking. Design, tune, and evaluate how we retrieve and rank search results so members find what they need and discover what they did not know to ask for. Bring real depth on ranking.
  • Build our recommendation systems from the ground up. Intelligent recommendations are central to the discovery experience we are building. Design robust recommendation algorithms, model member and project intent, and figure out what to surface, when, and where across the experience.
  • Explore the data to find the strategy. Run exploratory analysis on behavioral and catalog data to figure out which approaches fit our members and our catalog. The answers are not known yet; a large part of this job is asking the right questions and finding them in the data.
  • Apply advanced query understanding. Improve query parsing, intent recognition, and semantic understanding for diverse, messy real-world queries, including the long tail.
  • Raise data quality. Search and recommendation quality is downstream of catalog quality. Identify the data problems that hold relevance back and help fix them.
  • Do R&D you can ship. Invent the formulas, models, and re-ranking approaches and build working versions yourself. Iterate and reformulate quickly, then collaborate with engineering to productionize what proves out.
  • Iterate visual and color approaches. Evaluate image-based search and color matching, including perceptual color, and decide what is right for us.
  • Measure what matters. Build and extend evaluation frameworks and success metrics so we know whether a change actually helped, and design experiments as traffic grows.
  • Collaborate across functions. Work closely with product, engineering, and catalog to turn research into shipped improvements.

What you'll need

  • A track record building search, recommendations, or ranking systems that shipped to real users and moved the numbers. You have done this work before, not just studied it.
  • An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, machine learning, statistics, or applied math, or equivalent hands-on experience that got you to the same place.
  • Deep understanding of search and recommendation systems, especially retrieval, ranking, and relevance. This is the core of the role.
  • Strong query understanding and NLP, including semantic and embedding-based retrieval.
  • Real exploratory and experimental rigor: statistical modeling, experimental design, and hypothesis testing, plus comfort working in ambiguity where the right approach is not yet known.
  • Hands-on building ability. You prototype and implement your own ideas. We do not care which language you are strongest in.
  • Some experience deploying ML or data systems to production, or partnering closely on it.

Nice to have

  • Experience with multimodal or image-based search, and with color or perceptual science.
  • E-commerce or marketplace search and recommendations experience.
  • Experience managing vendor and home-grown systems in conjunction with one another.

Why this role is unusual and exciting

Most search science roles plug into a mature stack with the strategy already decided. This one does not. You set the approach, build it, and prove it, with a clear runway toward owning more of the search and recommendations system over time. If you want the surface area of a founding scientist for a search function inside an established, well-funded company, this is that.

What you’ll get from us:

  • Our people: We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution.
  • Relaxation and Celebrations: Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect).
  • Health Benefits: We contribute to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term disability plans and have a strong employee assistance program.
  • Plan for your Retirement: 401(k) eligible after your first 90 day's employed!
  • Giving Back: We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities.
  • Growth: We’ll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters!
  • Flexible Work Schedules: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a hybrid  working model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.

Material Bank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status or other status protected under any applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
About Hone

Hone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

  • Fight for the Customer
  • Execute Ruthlessly
  • Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly
  • Collaborate Selflessly
  • Practice Calculated Risk-Taking
  • Maximize Joy and Gratitude

Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

The Role

Hone is looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Marketing to join our growing data team. In this role, you will report to the Sr. Director, Data, Analytics, and Machine Learning and partner closely with Marketing, Growth, and Product stakeholders to improve customer acquisition, conversion, and retention through data-driven insights and modeling.

You will focus on building and applying statistical models, experiments, and analyses that inform marketing strategy, optimize funnel performance, and improve customer lifetime value. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership over execution and delivery. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys translating business questions into machine learning solutions, shipping high-quality work independently, and collaborating cross-functionally to drive tangible results.

Primary Responsibilities

Key responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to) the following:

  • Partner with Marketing teams to analyze and optimize the full customer funnel, including acquisition, conversion, retention, and churn.
  • Build and maintain statistical models and analyses related to key marketing use cases such as attribution, LTV, CAC, churn prediction, cohort analysis, and conversion optimization.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret experiments (A/B and multivariate tests) across marketing channels and on-site experiences, ensuring statistical rigor and clear recommendations.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into well-scoped analytical projects with clear success metrics and timelines.
  • Collaborate with data engineering and analytics engineering partners to define data requirements and ensure reliable, well-modeled datasets for marketing analytics.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders through presentations, dashboards, and written documentation.
  • Contribute to shared analytics and modeling best practices within the data science team, including code quality, validation, and documentation.
  • Support junior team members through informal mentorship, code review, and knowledge sharing where appropriate.
  • Stay current on industry trends and techniques in marketing analytics, experimentation, and applied data science, and apply them pragmatically to Hone’s context.

Qualifications

In order to qualify for this role, candidates must meet the following criteria:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Analytics, or a related quantitative role.
  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, statistics, and modeling.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with production analytics datasets.
  • Experience applying data science to marketing or growth problems, including funnel analysis, experimentation, attribution, or retention modeling.
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods, experimentation design, and model evaluation.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, agile environments with marketing, product, or business stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience working in cloud-based data environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits*

Hone wants our team to be in the best condition of their lives, so we offer a range of benefits including:

  • A remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation and equity options
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Short-term disability and basic life coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
  • Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs)
  • We follow federal holidays and have uncapped time off for exempt employees
  • Budget for the technology tools you need (laptop, monitor, and/or special software)
  • A focus on company-sponsored activities to foster engagement (both virtual and in-person)
  • Waived membership fees for any Hone team members utilizing Hone products

*These benefits are available to full-time, regular employees, and not to independent contractors, part-time employees, temporary employees, or interns.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description:
Yopeso has been developing a diverse range of software products, from large-scale applications to smaller solutions, for 20 years. With a growing team of over 300 employees across five locations, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of growth, transparency, and professionalism.

At Yopeso, we value authenticity, curiosity, and ambition. These values drive us to build strong connections within our community and with our partners, ensuring trust, integrity, and transparency in all our business practices. We strive to maintain the highest professional standards and continuously challenge ourselves to develop high-quality, high-performance, and secure software solutions.

Our approach is rooted in efficient collaboration among passionate professionals working in agile teams. Guided by curiosity and ambition, we strive to create products that are meaningful and impactful, while remaining true to our authentic selves.

Requirements

We are looking for an Integration Specialist to lead the successful integration of companies acquired into our organization, and to build a repeatable integration capability we can apply to future mergers and acquisitions. This role sits at the intersection of people, process, and culture - you'll work across teams and geographies to make sure an acquisition delivers on its intended value, not just on paper, but in how people actually work together day to day.

You will be the connective tissue between the acquiring organization and newly integrated teams: aligning ways of working, resolving friction before it becomes disruption, and building the playbook that makes the next integration faster and smoother than this one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end integration planning and execution for the acquisition, from Day 1 readiness through full operational and cultural integration.

  • Act as the primary point of contact between leadership, functional teams, and the acquired organization throughout the integration period.

  • Identify and resolve cross-cultural, communication, and process gaps between merging teams, drawing on experience working with cultures and teams around the world.

  • Design and track an integration roadmap with clear milestones, owners, and success metrics across HR, operations, systems, and culture workstreams.

  • Partner with People/HR, Finance, IT, and business unit leaders to align policies, tools, reporting lines, and ways of working.

  • Surface risks and blockers early, and propose pragmatic solutions rather than escalating without options.

  • Build and maintain integration documentation, playbooks, and lessons-learned repositories to support future M&A activity.

  • Support due diligence and pre-close planning on future acquisitions, bringing an integration lens to deal evaluation.

  • Facilitate workshops and check-ins to keep both sides of the integration aligned, transparent, and accountable to agreed actions.

  • Report integration progress and risks to leadership on a regular cadence.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior leadership.

  • Demonstrated experience working with people and teams from different cultures and countries, with genuine cross-cultural fluency, not just exposure.

  • Track record delivering international, cross-border, or multi-site projects.

  • Prior experience in M&A integration, post-merger integration (PMI), or a related change-management/transformation role.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills - able to build trust quickly with people who did not choose to be part of a merger.

  • Structured, organized approach: comfortable building roadmaps, tracking actions, and driving accountability without formal authority over every team involved.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities, typical of active deal environments.

  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed to support integration activities across locations.

Nice to Have

  • Additional languages beyond English.

  • Experience in the technology, software, or services sector.

  • Background in consulting, corporate development, or a dedicated M&A/integration function.

  • Familiarity with change-management frameworks and integration playbook design.

About the role

Isos Technology is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead our most complex, multi-client delivery within the professional services practice. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a PM who can own our highest-stakes engagements, set the standard for how we deliver, and raise the capability of the PMs around them.

At Isos, seniority isn’t about time in seat. We level on scope, complexity, influence, and sustained impact — not tenure. A Senior PM consistently operates at a higher level of complexity, carries our most demanding client relationships, and can be trusted to deliver in ambiguity without a playbook handed to them.

What you’ll do

  • Lead delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements, owning scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholders on each.
  • Take on the toughest, highest-visibility projects in the portfolio — the ones with the most moving parts, the most senior client stakeholders, or the most delivery risk.
  • Act as a consultative partner to clients, not just a coordinator — anticipating problems, guiding decisions, and protecting the outcome.
  • Set and hold delivery standards: consistent use of our internal processes, tooling, and artifacts (backlogs, schedules, status, governance) so quality doesn’t depend on who’s assigned.
  • Mentor and level up other PMs and delivery team members; serve as an SME and a model for how the role is done well.
  • Manage to your [billable/utilization target] while balancing the demands of several clients at once.

What sets a Senior PM apart (how we level)

Because we don’t level on tenure, these are the differentiators we look for:

  • Scope & complexity — you regularly run engagements of significant size, complexity, and stakeholder difficulty, and you’ve done it across a meaningful number of projects, not just once.
  • Multi-client capability (required) — you handle multiple clients simultaneously, with the context-switching, prioritization, and range that demands. Deeply dedicated single-client portfolio leadership is the Program Manager lane, not Senior PM.
  • Influence — you shape how we deliver, not just what gets delivered; other PMs and consultants are better because of how you work.
  • Consultative judgment — clients trust you with decisions, not just task tracking.
  • Order under ambiguity — you bring structure without needing everything pre-built for you.

Requirements

  • 6 years of project management experience in professional services or consulting delivery, including 6 years running multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, high-risk, or high-visibility projects to successful outcomes.
  • Strong command of both traditional and agile delivery (backlog management, iteration planning, product-owner collaboration).
  • Fluency in our delivery tooling ([Jira, Confluence]) and a track record of following and enforcing standard delivery processes.
  • Comfort in a lean, fast-changing environment — building what isn’t there rather than waiting for structure.

Preferred certifications & accreditations

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or comparable agile credential
  • Atlassian accreditations ([Jira, Confluence, relevant technical accreditations])
  • Relevant AI-delivery or tooling accreditations

Who thrives here

Isos is a lean, fast-evolving practice. The people who do best embrace ambiguity, treat gaps as a chance to put their mark on something rather than a problem handed to them, and can hold structure and flexibility in the same hand. If you need every process defined before you can move, this won’t be the right fit. If you like bringing order to a little healthy chaos, you’ll do well here.

About Isos Technology

Isos Technology is a premier consulting services provider dedicated to empowering organizations through technology, people, and best practices. Founded in 2005, we began by creating Enterprise Java solutions and quickly embraced Jira and Confluence to enhance our consulting practice. Recognizing the power of these tools, we transitioned to become an Atlassian Partner in 2014 and attained Platinum Solution Partner status in 2016. Today, we're focused solely on Atlassian, with a mission to excel as the top Atlassian consulting firm in the US. In 2022, Isos joined The Acacia Group and expanded its reach by acquiring MajorKey Technologies, HyperVelocity Consulting, and Stack Intelligence's Atlassian practices. This strategic growth solidifies our position as one of the largest Platinum Solution Partners in the Atlassian ecosystem!

This position is primarily a work from home position and we consider applicants throughout the United States. We support pay transparency and the On-Target Earnings range for this position is between $120,000 - 140,000 (this role is eligible for incentive compensation based on company performance) combined plus a suite of employee benefits, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan with an employer contribution. Actual compensation can vary based on qualifications, experience, additional incentive opportunities, and geographic pay differentials.

jobs.description:
Role Summary

We seek an architect-level Automation Framework Engineer to design, build, and scale enterprise automation frameworks across UI, API, document, and integration-heavy workflows. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience designing frameworks for scale, security, and long-term stability as applications, teams, and delivery pipelines evolve. This role includes AI-assisted QA initiatives using Azure OpenAI, Claude, and Azure DevOps integrations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable UI automation frameworks using Playwright and Selenium
  • Design frameworks supporting multiple teams, applications, environments, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Build reusable API and integration testing components (Postman, GraphQL, PactumJS, REST clients)
  • Support document-heavy and compliance-driven workflows (disclosure validation, OCR, document intelligence)
  • Implement automation observability: logging, diagnostics, flaky test detection, and trend reporting
  • Support AI-assisted automation: test generation, regression optimization, and failure triage

Required Experience

  • Deep hands-on experience building and maintaining enterprise automation frameworks
  • Advanced coding in TypeScript, JavaScript, or C#
  • Strong experience with Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks
  • Demonstrated CI/CD expertise, preferably with Azure DevOps
  • Ability to provide real-world examples of framework design decisions and tradeoffs

Core Evaluation Areas

Scale

Candidates must explain how they designed automation frameworks that scaled across teams, applications, and environments. Examples may include scaling test execution across CI/CD pipelines, supporting multiple products from one framework, designing reusable components, and managing test data and environment configuration.

Security

Describe security practices when building frameworks: secure credential management, avoiding hardcoded secrets, role-based access, secure test data handling, pipeline security, and protection of sensitive data.

Stability

Explain how automation remained stable as applications evolved: reducing flaky tests, maintaining reusable selectors, versioning framework components, handling application changes without large rewrites, and separating true defects from automation failures.

Nice to Have

  • Mortgage, lending, banking, or FinTech experience
  • Experience with compliance-heavy or document-heavy workflows
  • Experience with AI-assisted QA, Azure OpenAI, or Claude
  • Experience with Azure Document Intelligence
  • Experience optimizing regression test selection

Candidate Screening Guidance

This is an architect-level automation role. Candidates must discuss actual projects where they built, scaled, secured, or stabilized automation frameworks—not just concepts. Strong candidates naturally discuss scale, security, stability, framework architecture, CI/CD integration, and maintenance strategy with real-world examples and tradeoffs.

Candidates unable to provide detailed examples of real projects may not be the right fit.

Title: Travel Management Specialist
Location: Remote, Continental United States
Schedule: Full-time, Monday-Friday
Salary: $70,000-$85,000, commensurate with experience

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring a Travel Management Specialist to join our team and provide remote travel-management support to the Federal Retirement Thrift Investment Board (FRTIB).
In this role, you will provide end-to-end support for official Government travel, including travel planning, authorizations, reservations, vouchers, approval workflows, reimbursement processing, reporting, training, and electronic travel-system support.

This position is a strong fit for someone with substantial federal travel-program experience who is organized, customer-focused, comfortable training users, and skilled at translating complex travel regulations into clear and practical guidance.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
Federal Travel Planning & Authorizations
  • Assist employees with planning official Government travel and estimating anticipated travel costs
  • Help travelers identify airfare, lodging, meals and incidental expenses, rental vehicles, and other reimbursable expenses
  • Prepare, review, route, and monitor travel authorizations before official travel begins
  • Verify accounting codes, funding lines, supporting documentation, and required justifications
  • Ensure travel requests comply with the Federal Travel Regulation, GSA guidance, and Agency policies
  • Establish and maintain appropriate supervisory, budgetary, and financial approval paths
  • Resolve returned actions, routing errors, incomplete documentation, and approval delays
  • Provide additional coordination for international, VIP, and other high-visibility travel
Reservation & Booking Support
  • Assist travelers with airfare, lodging, and rental-car reservations
  • Make, modify, or cancel reservations electronically or through the appropriate Travel Management Center
  • Verify Government city-pair fares, lodging per diem limits, and applicable travel requirements
  • Determine the appropriate use of Individually Billed Accounts and Centrally Billed Accounts
  • Coordinate itinerary changes and cancellations resulting from mission or administrative needs
  • Support web-based reservation functions and apply knowledge of Global Distribution Systems
Travel Vouchers & Reimbursement
  • Prepare, review, route, and monitor travel vouchers and local vouchers
  • Compare vouchers against approved travel authorizations and supporting documentation
  • Review claimed expenses for accuracy, allowability, and regulatory compliance
  • Validate mileage, transit, parking, lodging, airfare, and other allowable travel expenses
  • Identify and resolve errors that could delay reimbursement
  • Support electronic processing of approved reimbursements through the financial-management system
Electronic Travel-System Support
  • Provide functional and technical support for E2 Solutions and associated travel systems
  • Assist users with travel authorizations, reservations, vouchers, reimbursements, and system navigation
  • Troubleshoot system errors, workflow issues, and travel-system integration problems
  • Create, configure, and maintain travel workflows and approval-routing paths
  • Administer protected user roles, permissions, and role-based access
  • Coach users on travel-system functions and proper travel-processing procedures
Go.gov Transition Support
  • Assist with planning and implementing the Agency's transition from E2 Solutions to Go.gov
  • Map existing authorization, voucher, approval, payment, and reporting workflows to Go.gov
  • Support system configuration, user-role administration, workflow validation, and readiness activities
  • Assist with system testing, issue resolution, and process adjustments
  • Help maintain uninterrupted travel operations throughout the transition
  • Support users before, during, and after Go.gov implementation
Training & Customer Support
  • Deliver travel-related and electronic travel-system training to Agency personnel
  • Provide live virtual training sessions, webinars, and remote desk-side support
  • Develop or deliver short instructional modules for onboarding, system updates, policy changes, and refresher training
  • Provide limited in-person classroom training when specifically requested
  • Explain Federal Travel Regulation and Agency requirements in clear, user-friendly language
  • Maintain responsive and professional customer support throughout each travel action
Reporting & Program Support
  • Extract and compile information from the electronic travel system and related systems
  • Prepare Government travel, travel-card, management, compliance, and audit-support reports
  • Review travel data for accuracy and completeness
  • Maintain supporting documentation and records in approved formats
  • Apply quality-control procedures to travel actions, workflows, reports, and deliverables
  • Support quarterly reporting, phase-in planning, and phase-out planning
  • Protect Government Furnished Information and Government Furnished Property
  • Perform related federal travel-management duties within the scope of the position

REQUIRED BACKGROUND
  • Minimum of 3 years of federal agency travel-program experience
  • Demonstrated experience processing federal travel authorizations and vouchers
  • Strong working knowledge of the Federal Travel Regulation
  • Experience using E2 Solutions or another federal electronic travel system

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.excerpt: Do you instinctively click through a competitor's checkout just to see where they're losing people?
jobs.description:
Do you instinctively click through a competitor's checkout just to see where they're losing people?

Do you open a PDP and immediately start forming hypotheses before you've even read the copy?

Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining grooming for the modern consumer. We've built one of the strongest paid acquisition engines in DTC. The next phase of growth isn't about more traffic. It's about designing experiences that convert, retain, and compound.

We're looking for a UX/UI Designer who doesn't just make things look good, but builds the design system and conversion-focused surfaces that make the numbers move. This role owns the Freebird visual execution layer, the component library that scales it, and the high-stakes pages where customers decide whether to buy.

This is not a "here are the brand guidelines, go design some screens" role. You'll be hands-on in Figma every day, running A/B test variants, maintaining a design system that the entire organization depends on, and shipping production-ready work within sprint cadence, with metrics attached to every major decision.

You'll report to the Senior Director of Design and partner closely with our CRO Manager. This role is 100% remote. We require meaningful overlap with US working hours.

If you think in components, conversion hypotheses, and funnel mechanics, and you've been waiting for a seat where design decisions are measured, not debated, this role is for you.

What You'll Own:

Design the Surfaces That Drive Revenue

  • Own UX/UI for conversion-critical pages, including PDPs, checkout flows, landing pages, CTAs, and post-purchase experiences.
  • Design every A/B test variant with a clear hypothesis and defined success metric before it goes into development.
  • Evaluate test results and iterate. Winning patterns get documented, while losing variants get analyzed.
  • Partner with the CRO Manager to build and maintain a design hypothesis backlog that is never empty or stale.
  • Identify friction points in the customer journey using heatmaps, session replays, and analytics, then turn insights into test briefs.

Build and Own the Freebird Design System

The design system is not a side project. It is the foundation that makes everything else scalable.

  • Own the component library, design tokens, and pattern documentation in Figma.
  • Maintain version control and governance so the system grows predictably without introducing drift.
  • Act as the consistency gatekeeper by reviewing team output, flagging deviations, and evolving the system as Freebird's product lines expand.
  • Create clear specifications and acceptance criteria that enable smooth implementation with minimal back-and-forth.

Ship Production-Ready UI at Sprint Velocity

  • Take stakeholder briefs to polished, production-ready designs within sprint cadence.
  • Maintain pixel-perfect execution across web and app experiences.
  • Deliver clean handoffs to the development team with complete specifications, interaction notes, and edge-case coverage.
  • Contribute to sprint planning and grooming by estimating work accurately, flagging risks early, and delivering on commitments.

Scale the Design Function

  • Help establish scalable design practices as the team grows, including critique culture, file organization, and handoff standards.
  • Set the quality bar the team builds toward through strong execution and high standards.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months:

  • A documented, scalable design system is used consistently across all digital touchpoints.
  • A steady cadence of design-led experiments ships alongside the CRO roadmap.
  • Measurable improvements in CTR, CVR, or AOV are directly tied to design decisions you made.
  • Design handoffs are clean, complete, and require minimal clarification from engineering.
  • Junior designers have a clear quality standard and structured way of working.
  • You become the internal authority on the Freebird design system and its evolution.

Requirements

We're looking for an execution-first designer with strong CRO instincts, not just someone who creates beautiful interfaces.

  • 4-7 years of UX/UI design experience, with significant experience in DTC or e-commerce, specifically PDPs, checkout flows, and subscription experiences. This experience is required.
  • Proven experience building, maintaining, and scaling design systems in Figma, including components, variants, design tokens, and documentation.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates measurable business impact, including conversion improvements, increased CTR, CVR gains, AOV growth, or similar performance metrics.
  • Experience working through the full experimentation process, from hypothesis development and variant design to analyzing results and iterating.
  • Ability to work independently, proactively communicate blockers, and maintain momentum without waiting for perfect processes.
  • Comfortable presenting and defending design decisions using customer insights and performance data.
  • Advanced Figma proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working closely with a CRO or experimentation team.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or headless commerce environments.
  • Background in direct-response marketing or performance creative.
  • Experience building a design system from scratch at a DTC brand.

Benefits

  • Your design decisions are measured. You'll see the impact of your work through real business results.
  • No politics, just execution. Join a fast-moving, high-ownership, results-driven culture.
  • Make your mark by helping scale a 9-figure DTC brand on the verge of global breakout.
  • Kind, people-focused team that communicates openly, collaborates well, and supports one another.
  • We embrace growth and change, never settle, and continuously improve.
  • We move fast, keep things simple, and innovate without fear.
  • Remote-first and flexible. Work from anywhere with autonomy and trust.
  • Unlimited PTO. Recharge when you need to, without counting days.

This role provides technical leadership in acquisition, processing, interpretation, and integration of remote sensing datasets to identify prospective targets, reduce exploration risk, and enhance decision-making across exploration programs. Working closely with geology, geochemistry, geophysics, and field teams, the Remote Sensing Lead ensures that remote sensing insights are translated into actionable exploration decisions and strategies that accelerate target generation, optimize field campaigns, and support sustainable, cost-effective mineral exploration.
