Oracle PL/SQL Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Oracle PL/SQL Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise database solutions supporting high-volume transactional systems, financial applications, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical business operations. This role focuses on building scalable PL/SQL applications, optimizing complex SQL queries, developing database objects, and ensuring high availability and performance across large Oracle environments.
You will work closely with application developers, database administrators, data architects, QA engineers, and business analysts to build efficient database solutions that support enterprise applications, cloud modernization initiatives, and data integration platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Oracle Database technologies, advanced PL/SQL programming, query optimization, and performance tuning while maintaining high standards for data integrity, security, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex PL/SQL packages, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects supporting enterprise applications.
  • Develop highly optimized SQL queries for large transactional and analytical databases.
  • Design scalable database schemas, indexing strategies, partitioning models, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Build ETL processes and database integration components for enterprise data movement and synchronization.
  • Develop batch processing jobs and automated database workflows supporting business-critical operations.
  • Analyze execution plans, identify SQL bottlenecks, and optimize database performance for high-volume systems.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to design efficient database access patterns and API integrations.
  • Implement database security, auditing, role-based access controls, and data encryption standards.
  • Develop database migration scripts, deployment packages, and release automation processes.
  • Perform database code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and resolve complex data integrity problems.
  • Support database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure, or AWS.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, architecture reviews, and production support rotations.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional experience developing enterprise Oracle database solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Oracle PL/SQL including packages, stored procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, collections, exceptions, and dynamic SQL.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with complex joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), analytical functions, window functions, and query optimization.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle Database 12c, 19c, or newer enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle indexing, partitioning, materialized views, execution plans, and optimizer statistics.
  • Experience optimizing high-volume OLTP and OLAP database workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle SQL Developer, TOAD, SQL*Plus, or similar Oracle development tools.
  • Experience developing ETL processes and integrating Oracle databases with external systems.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Data Pump, RMAN, and database migration methodologies.
  • Experience working with Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ), Scheduler, and database jobs.
  • Experience integrating Oracle databases with Java, .NET, Python, or REST-based enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of database normalization, data modeling, and relational database design principles.
  • Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines for database deployment automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Database Services or Autonomous Database.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Exadata, RAC (Real Application Clusters), and Data Guard environments.
  • Experience with Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Oracle SOA Suite.
  • Knowledge of Oracle APEX application development.
  • Experience developing financial, healthcare, insurance, retail, or government enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud migration strategies from on-premises Oracle databases to OCI, Azure, or AWS.
  • Experience with shell scripting, Python, or PowerShell for database automation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts.
  • Oracle Database Administration or Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certifications are highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated environments requiring auditability, compliance, and data governance.

Project Environment
You will be joining an enterprise data engineering and application modernization team responsible for supporting mission-critical Oracle database platforms serving multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise financial transaction processing systems
  • Healthcare claims and patient management platforms
  • Insurance policy administration and billing systems
  • Large-scale ERP and supply chain applications
  • Cloud migration of Oracle databases to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Regulatory reporting and compliance data platforms
  • Enterprise data integration and batch processing solutions
  • High-availability Oracle environments supporting millions of daily transactions
  • Performance optimization and modernization of legacy PL/SQL applications
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to database architecture, PL/SQL development, SQL optimization, cloud migration, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise Oracle platforms.

VIDIZMO is expanding its Public Safety Sales team and seeking experienced sales professionals to develop business with law-enforcement, justice, and public-safety organizations across the United States. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, AI-driven environment and wants to directly influence revenue outcomes—not just activity metrics.

VIDIZMO is a U.S.-based technology company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, and a Microsoft Solutions Partner across Data & AI, Infrastructure, and Digital & App Innovation. Through our AI-powered Intelligence Hub, we help Fortune 500 enterprises, government agencies, and public sector organizations securely manage, analyze, and govern complex data with full control and compliance.

Our Multimodal AI Data Intelligence Platform uses Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to enable advanced capabilities such as automated tagging, redaction, summarization, OCR, translation, subtitle generation, object detection and tracking, intelligent search, sentiment and emotion analysis, topic extraction, document classification, and facial recognition.

Role Overview

These are quota-carrying positions responsible for selling enterprise software and AI solutions to police departments, sheriff’s offices, district attorneys, public defenders, courts, corrections agencies, state investigative organizations, emergency-management agencies, and federal law-enforcement organizations. Candidates should have experience selling enterprise technology to government agencies and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder procurement processes. Each sales professional will be assigned a geographic territory, customer segment, or strategic market based on experience and existing relationships.

You will sell enterprise software and AI solutions to police departments, sheriff's offices, district attorneys, courts, corrections agencies, state investigative organizations, emergency management agencies, and federal law enforcement organizations. You will own a defined territory, customer segment, or strategic market based on your experience and existing relationships.

What You Will Sell

  • Digital Evidence Management System
  • AI assisted investigation and evidence analysis
  • Automated redaction of video, audio, images, and documents
  • Body worn camera and in car video evidence management
  • Case centric evidence organization and secure sharing
  • Prosecutor, public defender, and discovery workflows
  • Private cloud, dedicated cloud, on premises, and air gapped deployments

Key Responsibilities

Territory and Pipeline Development

  • Build and execute a business plan for your assigned territory or market
  • Generate opportunities through direct outreach, referrals, partners, and procurement channels
  • Build relationships with chiefs, sheriffs, prosecutors, investigators, CIOs, CISOs, and procurement officials
  • Maintain a qualified pipeline sufficient to meet quarterly and annual targets

Consultative Selling

  • Run discovery sessions to understand each agency's operational, legal, and security requirements
  • Translate agency needs into the right technical and business solution
  • Present to executive, technical, legal, and procurement stakeholders
  • Lead product demonstrations, workshops, and proof of concept evaluations

Deal and Contract Management

  • Own the full sales process from qualification through negotiation and contract award
  • Prepare proposals, pricing, and statements of work
  • Lead or support RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses
  • Navigate government procurement, budget cycles, and contract vehicles
  • Maintain accurate forecasts in the CRM

Market and Partner Development

  • Build relationships with RMS, CAD, body camera, cloud, and systems integration partners
  • Represent VIDIZMO at public safety conferences and industry events
  • Share market feedback with product and marketing teams

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, or government technology sales
  • Demonstrated experience selling to law enforcement, justice agencies, or government organizations
  • Proven track record of generating pipeline and meeting or exceeding quota
  • Experience managing complex, multi stakeholder government sales cycles
  • Understanding of public sector budgeting and procurement processes
  • Strong discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • CRM experience for pipeline management and forecasting
  • Willingness to travel for meetings, demos, and conferences
  • Authorization to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing relationships within law enforcement, prosecution, or public safety agencies
  • Experience selling digital evidence management, video management, or AI solutions
  • Familiarity with FBI CJIS Security Policy and related public sector security requirements
  • Experience with government contract vehicles and cooperative purchasing programs
  • Bachelor's degree in business, criminal justice, IT, or a related field

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Build a prioritized territory and target account plan
  • Establish a sustainable pipeline of qualified public safety opportunities
  • Develop relationships with key agency decision makers
  • Secure new customers and meet assigned bookings targets
  • Provide market feedback that strengthens our public safety go to market strategy

Background and Security Requirements

Depending on territory and customer assignments, selected candidates may be required to:

  • Complete employment background screening.
  • Complete fingerprint-based screening when required.
  • Complete CJIS security awareness and customer-specific training.
  • Sign confidentiality, acceptable-use, and security agreements.
  • Follow agency requirements governing access to facilities, systems, and Criminal Justice Information.
  • Maintain eligibility to enter government and law-enforcement facilities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VIDIZMO is an equal-opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, performance, merit, and business requirements. VIDIZMO provides equal employment opportunities without unlawful discrimination.

jobs.title: Adviseur en Projectmanager Innovatiemilieus (medior)
jobs.excerpt: Wil jij steden en regio’s economisch vooruithelpen?
jobs.description:
Wil jij steden en regio’s economisch vooruithelpen? Werk je graag aan plekken waar innovatie, werken en leren samenkomen? Heb je affiniteit met ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, regionale economie en samenwerking tussen overheden, bedrijven en kennisinstellingen? Wil je impact maken op campussen en innovatiedistricten die bepalend zijn voor de economische en maatschappelijke ontwikkeling van Nederland? Dan pas je bij TwynstraGudde.

Jouw rol

Als medior adviseur en projectmanager innovatiemilieus werk je aan complexe ruimtelijk‑economische opgaven rond campussen, science parks en innovatiedistricten. Dit zijn plekken waar ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, economische strategie en samenwerking samenkomen. Je adviseert opdrachtgevers over de (door)ontwikkeling van deze innovatiemilieus: van het bepalen van een heldere ontwikkelstrategie tot het organiseren van samenwerking en het begeleiden van besluitvorming.

Je werkt aan vraagstukken zoals:

  • hoe positioneer je een campus of innovatiedistrict ruimtelijk en economisch?

  • hoe ondersteunt ruimtelijke ontwikkeling het innovatie‑ecosysteem optimaal?

  • hoe organiseer je effectieve samenwerking tussen triple‑helixpartners (overheden, bedrijven en kennisinstellingen)?

  • hoe vertaal je ambities naar haalbare en uitvoerbare plannen?

Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van ruimte, economie en organisatie. Je vervult afwisselend een adviserende, procesbegeleidende of projectmatige rol. Wat ons werk aan innovatiemilieus onderscheidt, is de integrale benadering. We combineren kennis van hardware (vastgoed en gebiedsontwikkeling), software (ecosysteem ontwikkeling en innovatie) én orgware (governance en samenwerken). Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s, leert on the job en krijgt coaching.


Jouw werkzaamheden.

  • Initiëren van marktkansen en gesprek aangaan met een (potentiële) klanten;

  • Adviseren over ruimtelijk‑economische strategieën voor campussen en innovatiedistricten;

  • Analyseren van complexe opgaven en het vertalen van ambities naar concrete ontwikkelrichtingen en aanpakken;

  • Begeleiden van samenwerkingsprocessen tussen publieke en private partijen, inclusief bestuurlijke en politieke besluitvorming;

  • Bijdragen aan haalbaarheidsstudies, ontwikkelstrategieën en businesscases voor ruimtelijke ontwikkeling;

  • Verbinden van inhoud, belangen en mensen, met oog voor bestuurlijke en maatschappelijke context.

Je projecten kunnen langlopend zijn maar ook kortlopend. Bij langlopende projecten word je ingezet om met inbreng van jouw competenties de strategie van een opgave te realiseren. Hierdoor doe je veel kennis op hoe het in de praktijk écht werkt. Bij kortlopende opdrachten heb je een adviserende rol. Daarbij werk je veelal in teamverband, binnen de adviesgroep of met andere adviesgroepen binnen TwynstraGudde, aan een vraag van een opdrachtgever.

Requirements

Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met regionale economische ontwikkeling, bij voorkeur met innovatiemilieus. Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, analytisch en nieuwsgierig naar hoe innovatie, economie en ruimte elkaar versterken. Je voelt je thuis in complexe omgevingen met meerdere belangen en brengt structuur aan zonder de samenwerking uit het oog te verliezen. Je werkt graag samen, neemt initiatief en durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je staat open voor feedback en reflectie.

Wat we van je vragen:

  • WO-werk- en denkniveau;

  • Bij voorkeur een opleiding in een ruimtelijk-economische richting (bijvoorbeeld gebiedsontwikkeling, planologie of economische geografie);

  • In staat om invulling te geven aan strategische vragen én deze te kunnen vertalen naar een aanpak/ de uitvoering;

  • Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in ruimtelijke of economische opgaven.

  • Ambitie om jezelf te ontwikkelen zowel persoonlijk als professioneel.

Bij TwynstraGudde stimuleren we een inclusieve werkplek waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Meer weten? Lees dan ons diversiteit en inclusie statement.

Over ons
Wij zijn TwynstraGudde Ruimte, Wonen en Economie. Wij werken als adviseurs, kwartiermakers en managers aan complexe ruimtelijke vraagstukken van publieke, semipublieke en private partijen. Haalbaarheid en uitvoerbaarheid zijn voor ons daarbij sleutelwoorden. Kenmerken van deze vraagstukken zijn de aanwezigheid van een maatschappelijke component, de complexe politiek bestuurlijke omgeving en het lokale of regionale schaalniveau.

Wij maken impact op morgen én op overmorgen. Creatief zijn we, soms grensverleggend en tegelijkertijd pragmatisch. Opdrachtgevers kunnen op ons rekenen: onze kracht is om van idee naar strategie en tot realisatie te komen. Wij doen dit door partijen te verbinden, ontwikkelstrategieën uit te denken, een plan haalbaar te maken én echt tot uitvoering te brengen.

We werken aan de ontwikkeling van campussen en innovatiedistricten door ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, innovatie‑ecosystemen en organisatie & governance integraal te benaderen. We helpen regio’s en locaties om hun ambities werkend te krijgen, met oog voor haalbaarheid en draagvlak.

Help jij hen, samen met ons, vooruit?

We worden enthousiast van praktische en werkende oplossingen. We hanteren een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard, zijn ambitieus én collegiaal. We streven actief naar meer diversiteit en inclusiviteit en nodigen nadrukkelijk kandidaten van alle achtergronden uit om te reageren.

This is a remote position.

Trucking Mechanic Expert Witness

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Trucking Mechanic Expert to join our team of forensic and litigation support professionals. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced Heavy-Duty Diesel Mechanic, Shop Foreman, or Commercial Truck Technician with extensive hands-on experience diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining Class 7–8 commercial vehicles.

If you've spent your career working on heavy-duty trucks and understand how mechanical failures, maintenance practices, and vehicle inspections impact safety and performance, this is an opportunity to leverage your expertise as an expert witness. Prior expert witness experience is helpful but not required—we're looking for subject matter experts with deep industry knowledge.

In this role, you'll apply your real-world mechanical experience to legal cases involving commercial truck accidents, equipment failures, maintenance practices, repair standards, and compliance with federal transportation regulations.


Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Conduct forensic evaluations of commercial vehicles, including Class 7–8 trucks, tractor-trailers, braking systems, steering components, suspension systems, driveline components, tires, and fifth wheel/coupling systems.

  • Analyze mechanical failures and determine root causes related to improper maintenance, equipment failure, repair quality,orcomponent wear.

  • Review maintenance records, repair orders, inspection reports, and service histories to evaluate vehicle condition and maintenance practices.

  • Assess compliance with FMCSA regulations, DOT inspection requirements, OEM maintenance recommendations, and industry best practices.

  • Prepare clear, well-supported expert opinions and written reports based on your technical knowledge and forensic review.

  • Consult with commercial trucking experts on casesand, when needed, provide testimony during depositions or trials.

  • Stay current on commercial vehicle systems, diesel engine technology, braking systems, electronic diagnostics, and safety regulations.

Qualifications

  • At least 10 to 15 years of experience as a truck mechanic.

  • Extensive hands-on experience maintaining and repairing Class 7–8 commercial trucks.

  • Background as a Heavy-Duty Diesel Mechanic, Shop Foreman, Service Manager, or similar role.

  • Strong understanding of commercial truck mechanical systems, diagnostics, preventative maintenance, inspections, and repair procedures.

  • Familiarity with FMCSA regulations, DOT inspections, and commercial vehicle maintenance standards.

  • Ability to analyze complex mechanical issues and clearly explain findings.

  • Previous expert witness experience is a plus but not required.


Benefits

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation with flexible, case-based engagements.

  • Peer reviewsupportand access to a multidisciplinary team of experts across Trucking, Transportation Safety, Digital Forensics, Accident Reconstruction, and related specialties.

  • Professional report editing and peer review to ensure your opinions are clear, defensible, and aligned with industry standards.

  • Access to marketing and business development support, connecting you with high-impact cases involving trucking incidents and mechanical failures.

  • Ongoing coaching and deposition/testimony training to strengthen your effectiveness and confidence in legal settings.

  • A collaborative environment where yourexpertise directly supports the legal process while minimizing administrative burden and maximizing your impact.

The Executive Assistant (EA) to the Founder is a high-impact, full-time remote role designed to serve as the operational right hand to the owner of a multi-location restaurant group (6 locations based in San Diego, CA). As the first-ever EA hire for the business, this role bridges operational logistics, maintenance oversight, quality assurance, SOP development, and social media outreach.

The ideal candidate is a tech-fluent, Spanish-speaking go-getter who understands restaurant realities, excels at building structured systems out of raw tasks, and approaches work with flexibility.

Core Focus & Evolution

  • Immediate Focus (SOP Development & Franchising Readiness): Documenting standardized operational procedures (SOPs) across all departments to prepare the group for future franchising.

  • Future Scope (Phase 2): Expanding into bookkeeping support, payroll preparation, and higher-level financial administration as operational trust is established.

Key Responsibilities

1. SOP Documentation & Franchising Readiness (Primary Focus)

  • Standardize, write, and organize operational SOPs across maintenance, operations, and training to build a comprehensive library for future franchising.
  • Collaborate with internal leadership (e.g., Giang) to convert raw training packets, checklists, and documents into structured SOPs and digital Jolt operational packets.

2. Maintenance Logistics & Incident Response

  • Act as the primary contact for store-level maintenance calls across all 6 locations.
  • Track equipment logs, monitor service requests, and coordinate with external contractors for rapid repair resolution.
  • Document every resolved issue into an accessible SOP library (e.g., handling fryer breakdowns, HVAC issues, or plumbing failures).

3. Operational Quality Assurance & Spot Checks

  • Conduct routine random photo/data audits on the Jolt platform to ensure store managers and staff are accurately completing daily operational tasks (e.g., verifying photo submissions for restroom cleanliness).
  • Perform unannounced audit phone calls to all 6 restaurant locations at random times (e.g., weekday afternoons or weekend shifts) to test staff responsiveness and phone pickup times.


4. Social Media & Influencer Outreach

  • Execute routine Instagram administration and content scheduling.
  • Conduct direct message outreach to local influencers, community managers, and potential partners.
  • Ensure consistent brand messaging and repetitive marketing admin workflows across channels.

5. AI Tools & Dashboard Systems

  • Utilize Claude / Claude Workspaces daily to automate repetitive admin, organize unstructured operational data, and draft routine communications.
  • Maintain operational dashboards tracking key location metrics, including overtime trends and labor pulled from Toast POS.

6. Financial Administration (Phase 2)

  • Gradually support bookkeeping, payroll preparation, and financial tracking under the supervision of internal accounting as trust and performance history build.

Qualifications & Non-Negotiables

Must-Haves & Non-Negotiables:

  • Fluent Spanish Speaker (Required): Must be able to communicate fluently and easily with kitchen staff, store managers, and personnel.
  • Restaurant Industry Background: Prior experience working in or closely with restaurant/retail operations, including familiarity with industry vocabulary and concepts (e.g., HVAC units, grease traps, line equipment, POS flows).
  • Weekend & Urgent Response Availability: Flexible mindset with the ability to handle urgent issues or emergency calls outside standard hours (e.g., Saturday night equipment failures).
  • Schedule Flexibility: Ability to manage a flexible ~40-hour work week adapted around changing owner and store needs rather than strict 9-to-5 desk hours.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

  • Business Degree: A degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related field to support future bookkeeping, branding oversight, and data reporting.

  • Proactivity & Critical Thinking: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a self-starter attitude—able to turn loose ideas and chaotic problems into clean, repeatable SOPs.

Phased Onboarding & Security Protocols

Because this role handles sensitive operational and financial data, onboarding follows a structured, phased approach to access:

  • Phase 1 (Initial Setup): Communication channels, task management, vendor scheduling, and AI workspace integration. Password access is managed securely via password management software.
  • Phase 2 (Financial Integration): Phased introduction to internal accounting systems, managed using virtual, low-limit spend cards and supervised platform access. Full financial administration access is unlocked as trust and performance history are demonstrated.

Remote (US) with regular travel to DC and 3PL sites · Full-time · Reports to GM

About Breezy Golf

Breezy Golf is one of the fastest-growing golf apparel brands in the country, built at the intersection of golf
culture, comedy, and commerce. As part of the Bob Does Sports media ecosystem, Breezy sells direct-to-
consumer through Shopify and through a growing wholesale/B2B channel. The brand moves fast, and it
needs an operational backbone that moves faster.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Operations & Systems to own two things completely. First, the systems that
run our operation - our ERP, EDI, and every integration that touches them. Second, the physical movement
of goods from the container to the customer, across inbound freight, our distribution center, our 3PL
network, and wholesale/B2B fulfillment.

Systems ownership is not a side responsibility in this role. It is the center of it. You will be the single
accountable owner of our operational stack, configuring it, fixing it, onboarding partners to it, and ensuring
every number it produces is one the rest of the business can trust.

This is a role for an organized, process-driven operator, someone who builds SOPs, catches errors before
they compound, and holds vendors, partners, and teammates to a standard. You'll lead an Operations Team
and warehouse staff while personally owning the systems architecture that keeps inventory, orders, and
data accurate across channels.

What You'll Own

Systems Ownership: ERP, EDI & the Ops Stack
  • Own the operational systems stack outright: the ERP as the source of truth, its integrations with Shopify and our EDI provider, plus 3PL connections, shipping, and returns tooling.
  • Own item setup, order flows, inventory sync, and operational reporting in the ERP.
  • Own systems onboarding: 3PLs and tools onto the stack such as mappings, testing, documentation, and go-live.
  • Lead the Breezy systems transition: configuration, migration, and process redesign without disrupting daily shipping. Automating manual processes and enforcing data accuracy as you go.
Distribution, Fulfillment & Wholesale Ops
  • Partner with our distribution centers through the Operations Manager and warehouse team: throughput, order accuracy, on-time ship rates, and returns processing.
  • Manage the 3PL network and outbound carrier mix: SLAs, rate negotiations, capacity planning, service levels, and shipping cost per order.
  • Own peak readiness: staffing, inventory positioning, and carrier capacity for BFCM and major drops.
  • Own EDI operations with retail partners: order acknowledgment, ASNs, routing-guide compliance, labeling, and chargeback prevention and disputes.
Inventory, Inbound Logistics & Receiving
  • Own inventory accuracy: cycle counts, receiving discipline, and reconciliation across the DC, 3PLs, and systems.
  • Manage inbound freight from manufacturers: international freight, customs, duties, and delivery windows into the DC and 3PLs.
  • Serve as the operational liaison to apparel production: translate production timelines into receiving and launch readiness plans, and flag downstream risk early.
People, Process & Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Develop the Operations Team: clear KPIs, training, safety, and accountability.
  • Build and maintain SOPs for every recurring process; run a weekly ops metrics cadence covering accuracy, speed, and cost.
  • Partner with merchandising on inventory positioning and receiving timelines, marketing and commerce on launch and peak readiness, finance on freight and fulfillment budgets, and apparel production on inbound schedules.
What We're Looking For
  • Non-negotiable: Deep, hands-on ownership of a mid-market cloud ERP and EDI (SPS Commerce or similar) - you configure, troubleshoot, and improve the system yourself.
  • Experience onboarding new partners onto an ERP/EDI stack — retailer mappings, 3PL integrations, testing, and go-live.
  • 7+ years in logistics, fulfillment, or distribution operations for apparel or consumer products, with at least 2 years managing people.
  • Experience managing inbound international freight, customs, and duties into a domestic DC.
  • Proven 3PL management: selection, SLA negotiation, scorecarding, and knowing when to switch.
  • Wholesale/B2B operations experience with major-retailer compliance: routing guides, ASNs, and chargeback management.
  • A true Type A operator: detail-obsessed, process-driven, and calm under pressure.
  • Strong people manager who sets standards, gives direct feedback, and builds teams that run without daily firefighting.

jobs.excerpt: About Salvo SoftwareSalvo Software is a global firm that provides cost-effective software solutions to guide enterprises and startups through digital transformation.
jobs.description:
About Salvo Software

Salvo Software is a global firm that provides cost-effective software solutions to guide enterprises and startups through digital transformation. We build products that sit at the intersection of automotive diagnostics, embedded systems, and modern software architecture — shipping tools that real engineers rely on in production environments around the world.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior OTX Runtime Engineer to design and ship a production-grade runtime for the ISO 13209 Open Test sequence eXchange (OTX) standard. This is a deeply technical, high-ownership role at the core of Salvo's diagnostic toolchain.

You will own the full runtime stack — from XML deserialization and the object model through the type system, evaluator, executor, and extension framework — and integrate it with a D-Server layer that speaks ODX, UDS, and the D-PDU API. The work demands equal fluency in language-implementation concepts, Kotlin Multiplatform engineering, and automotive diagnostic protocols.

Key Responsibilities

OTX Runtime Core

  • Design and implement an ISO 13209-compliant OTX runtime, covering the full object model, deserializer, and type system.
  • Build a tree-walking interpreter for the OTX XML-based DSL, including AST design using sealed/algebraic data types.
  • Implement a variable scoping and parameter binding engine faithful to the OTX specification.
  • Develop the evaluator and executor pipeline, ensuring correct handling of procedural flows, conditions, loops, and exception handling as defined in ISO 13209-1/2.
  • Design and implement the OTX extension framework to support runtime-loadable extensions.
  • Handle streaming XML parsing with namespace resolution and xsi:type polymorphic deserialization.

D-Server & Diagnostic Integration

  • Integrate the runtime with a D-Server layer: implement ODX parsing, service catalog management, and UDS request/response encoding and decoding.
  • Implement built-in OTX extensions including DiagCom adapter, PDU-to-J2534 adapter, and log:/file:/str:/ext:/flash:/even: extensions.
  • Develop diagnostic application logic targeting J2534 and D-PDU API (ISO 22900-2) diagnostic interfaces.
  • Support flash programming workflows across multiple OEM configurations.

Kotlin Multiplatform & Quality

  • Ship the runtime as a Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) library targeting JVM and native platforms.
  • Write robust concurrent code using Kotlin Coroutines and Mutex primitives; debug and resolve production deadlocks.
  • Define and maintain a comprehensive test suite covering OTX conformance, edge cases in diagnostic protocol encoding, and runtime stability.
  • Participate in design reviews, contribute to internal documentation, and mentor team members on OTX and diagnostic protocol topics.

Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • Shipped an OTX-compliant runtime to production in any language.
  • Participated in development of a D-Server diagnostic interface, including ODX parsing and executing UDS services across multiple OEMs.
  • Deep, subject-matter-expert knowledge of ISO 13209-1/2 (OTX) and ISO 22901-1 (ODX).
  • Shipped at least one Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) library to production.
  • Production experience debugging concurrency issues using Kotlin Coroutines and Mutex.
  • Implemented a tree-walking interpreter for an XML-based DSL.
  • Designed ASTs using sealed or algebraic data types.
  • Handled streaming XML parsing with namespace resolution and xsi:type polymorphism.
  • Strong command of Kotlin; candidates with equivalent depth in Java, Scala, or C# will also be considered.

Diagnostic Protocol Knowledge

  • Subject-matter expert in UDS (ISO 14229), ISO-TP (ISO 15765), and CAN/CAN-FD (ISO 11898).
  • Experience developing diagnostic applications targeting J2534 and/or D-PDU API (ISO 22900-2).
  • Working knowledge of KW2000 and OBD-II (SAE J1979).
  • Experience with flash programming is a strong plus.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with commercial OTX authoring tools (e.g., ETAS EDIABAS OTX Studio, SOFTING).
  • Familiarity with commercial ODX authoring tools (e.g., Mazel & Quack OTX/ODX Editor).
  • Experience with heavy-duty vehicle diagnostics (SAE J1939).
  • Background in automotive OEM or Tier-1 supplier environments.

Communication Skills: Strong command of the English language, with excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to use appropriate email etiquette. (Advanced)

Client-Centric Approach: Skilled in quickly assessing client needs, tactfully handling difficult situations, and maintaining client satisfaction. (Advanced)

Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Google and other business software; ability to navigate web-based applications efficiently. (Intermediate)

Education: Bachelor’s degree required, or equivalent professional experience in a related field.

jobs.excerpt: We willen dat iedereen in Nederland de best mogelijke hypotheek heeft.
jobs.description:
We willen dat iedereen in Nederland de best mogelijke hypotheek heeft. Ons team bestaat uit meer dan 30 Fritsers die dagelijks Frits beter, slimmer, klantvriendelijker, bekender en leuker maken. Dat doen we samen. We dagen elkaar uit en staan voor elkaar klaar. Zo maken we die ambitie werkelijkheid. Wij zijn Frits.

Wat je van ons kunt verwachten

Wij helpen je graag goed op weg. Daarom zorgen wij ervoor dat de leads die je binnenkrijgt, van hoge kwaliteit zijn. Je helpt klanten om hen zo goed mogelijk inzicht te krijgen in de mogelijkheden. Met de hulp van onze slimme software. Die berekent alles in no-time en denkt meerdere scenario’s voor je uit. Zo kun jij je focussen op de klant.

Flexibiliteit is belangrijk. Je bent vrij om zelf je agenda in te delen en je uren te bepalen. Wil je naast je werk ook eigen klanten adviseren? Ga ervoor. Zelf kiezen waar je werkt? Jij bepaalt. En ga je op vakantie? Dan is er een team Fritsers die je klanten tijdelijk kunnen overnemen.

Waarom je bij ons past

Je houdt ervan om grenzen te verleggen. En ook van nieuwe dingen leren. Je levert graag mooie resultaten en zet alles op alles om klanten goed te helpen. Je werkt makkelijk samen en ziet niet snel dingen over het hoofd. Klinkt bekend? Dan voel je je hier als een vis in ‘t water.

Requirements

  • Je werkt al minimaal vijf jaar als adviseur.

  • Je hebt ervaring met klanten uit verschillende situaties. Denk aan starters, verhuizers, oversluiters of ondernemers.

  • Je hebt up-to-date WFT’s op zak.

Diversiteit & Inclusiviteit

Bij Frits is iedereen welkom. We vinden het superbelangrijk dat de werkomgeving van iedere Fritser veilig voelt en inclusief is. Onafhankelijk van wie je bent of waar je vandaan komt. Diversiteit maakt ons juist sterker, beter en zorgt ervoor dat we een open en heldere blik hebben. Om dit te behouden hebben we een sollicitatieprocedure opgezet waar iedereen gelijke kansen krijgt om aangenomen te worden. Welkom bij de Frits Family.

Extra informatie

Beloningsmodel

Bij Frits werken we met een beloningsmodel dat net even anders is. Zo krijg je bij ons geen uurtarief of stukloon maar word je betaald per fase: zo hebben we een oriëntatie-, advies- en bemiddelingsfase. Aan het einde van de maand berekent Frits hoeveel afgeronde fases je kunt factureren. Daarna hoef jij alleen nog de factuur te sturen: lekker makkelijk.

Het is natuurlijk ook fijn om concreet te weten wat je gaat verdienen. Per finaal akkoord verdien je gemiddeld EUR 640. De meeste zzp’ers die fulltime voor ons werken, sluiten gemiddeld 14-16 hypotheken per maand af. Afhankelijk van hoeveel je werkt, heb je zo een idee van wat je kunt verdienen.

Beschikbaarheid

Je bent vrij om je eigen uren in te delen en te bepalen waar je werkt. Op ons kantoor of liever thuis: wat jij het fijnst vindt. Het is wel belangrijk dat je minimaal 24 uur per week beschikbaar bent.

Fritser aan ‘t woord

Benieuwd naar het verhaal van een toekomstige collega? Marilyn werkt ook als zzp adviseur bij Frits! Je leest haar verhaal hier.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREOur mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities. Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact.We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

We are a growing, private-equity-backed business focused on meaningful work

OUR TEAM & CULTURE

We believe technology should strengthen communities and support the professionals who lead their programs. Our team is committed to building meaningful tools while fostering a workplace where people feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

We take the work seriously. We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

A senior C#/.NET engineer who modernizes the platform, not just maintains it

Our flagship product, Volunteer Impact, is a mature, revenue-generating platform built on VB.NET and .NET Framework. It works. It serves thousands of organizations. And it needs to move to .NET 10 and C# so we can hire, ship, and build on a modern stack.

You’ve done this before. You’ve been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-modern-.NET migration of a real production monolith where downtime had to be tightly managed. You know how to migrate incrementally without breaking a live system, and your opinions come from experience, not theory. You’ve lived in NHibernate, swapped out legacy DI containers and dead dependencies, and dealt with custom security frameworks that predate ASP.NET Core’s policy model.

You’re still hands-on. You write code daily, configure your own CI pipelines, and can replace a legacy dependency, validate the regression risk, and ship the change to production. You want a role where you own the company’s most important technical initiative, not one where you draw architecture diagrams and hand them off.

You do serious work with a small core team, supported by fractional DevOps and release expertise when it matters, and a dedicated quality engineering function that owns the regression gate protecting this migration. You own the technical path, make sound trade-offs, and work directly with those partners to move the platform forward. You’re here to build the engineering foundation, not inherit one.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the migration of the Volunteer Impact backend from VB.NET/.NET Framework to C#/.NET 10, defining the migration approach and executing it incrementally against a live production system
  • Modernize a custom security framework (70+ custom attributes) into something that works on the new stack, with zero authorization bypasses
  • Strengthen the existing CI/CD pipeline and, with our quality engineering function, wire in the gates that catch functional and performance regressions before they reach production
  • Ship migrated areas to production independently and incrementally while the legacy application keeps running
  • Become the second engineer who can independently cut, validate, and deploy a production release
  • Identify, evaluate, and replace legacy dependencies that don’t have a path forward to modern .NET, without introducing functional or performance regressions
  • Make the technical sequencing calls: which areas migrate first, which dependencies get replaced when, and where automated conversion is viable vs. manual rewrite
  • Lay the foundation for the team to grow by modernizing the stack to one that any C# developer can contribute to

Requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8+ years of professional C#/.NET experience, with real depth in the framework, not just the latest version
  • You’ve personally led or been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-.NET Core (or later) migration of a large, production monolith serving paying customers
  • You’ve migrated a production system incrementally with minimal downtime and can articulate the approach you’d take here
  • Deep NHibernate experience is strongly preferred. We’re keeping NHibernate to reduce migration risk, so the value is understanding a mature data access layer, preserving existing behaviour, and knowing where modernization helps without unnecessary churn.
  • You’ve replaced legacy dependencies in production: DI containers, bundling frameworks, service hosting, and unsupported third-party libraries. You know how to swap critical components while the plane is flying.
  • Hands-on experience with legacy .NET ecosystem components: ASP.NET MVC-to-Core routing, custom security frameworks, and the kinds of dependencies that don’t have a clean upgrade path
  • Familiarity with migrating SSRS reports to a modern reporting platform is a benefit. We have a significant reporting footprint, so preserving report behaviour during that move would be valuable.
  • You’ve improved CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications and know how to work with a quality function to build gates that catch functional and performance regressions early
  • You’re comfortable in a small core team with shared DevOps and DBA support available, and a dedicated quality engineering partner who owns the regression gate across our platforms. You can make sound technical decisions, debug hands-on, and know when to pull the right support in.
  • VB.NET familiarity is a bonus, not a requirement. The job is the conversion, not maintaining VB.NET.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿401(k) (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿Unlimited vacation + 9 paid holidays
  • ﻿﻿Paid parental leave
  • ﻿﻿Competitive comp package

Who You'll Work With

The OpenConfig team who are responsible for building a dynamic, programmable data centre infrastructure using software-defined networking principles such as declarative configuration and model-driven management and operations.

What You'll Do

Arista’s engineering team started from a blank sheet of paper to architect an entirely new networking operating system. Arista’s unique architecture is based on three guiding principles:

1. State orientation

2. Open standards-based approach

3. Single software image consistency

1) State Orientation for publish-subscribe communication

State Orientation uses a unique multi-process state-sharing architecture that separates state information from protocol processing and application logic with a central database shared by diverse applications. Both system state and data are stored in the system database where data is accessed via an automated publish/subscribe model. This distinct design principle provides module independence, self-healing resiliency, and multi-process software stability. It is an elegant distributed systems solution applied holistically right across the network. This contrasts with the decades-old legacy approach of many competitors that uses extensive inter-process communications (IPC), a shared memory bus, or a complex message passing framework to communicate across the system components.

2) An Open Approach

Arista took to heart the lessons of the open-source world and built EOS on top of an unmodified Linux kernel, maintaining full, secured access to the Linux shell and utilities. It is notable that it is the same Linux OS that Arista’s customers run in their data centers and on their servers. This foundational methodology enables EOS to preserve the security, feature development, and tools of the Linux community, unlike legacy approaches where the original OS kernel is either modified or based on older, less maintained versions. By adhering to open source Linux, EOS also natively supports Linux containers and virtual machines, simplifying the deployment of new services and enhancing DevOps practices.

3) A Single Image

Arista’s third and crucial guiding principle is to provide a single software image that runs across all products in various packaging forms - physical platforms, virtual machines, and containers. The EOS single image uses the same source code, and the same version of the software released across the entire portfolio of switches and routers, thus improving network testing and reliability while reducing the complexity and cost of network operations. This approach is a large differentiator to legacy vendors who use multiple operating systems with numerous images to implement a siloed network. Managing these multiple software images with quality control testing or new features testing multiplies operational costs. In contrast, when Arista releases a new software version, customers merely deploy a single image network-wide. In addition, having a single image improves automation workflows by allowing DevOps tools, such as Ansible or Terraform, to work across all Arista devices with a single integration. Using these integrations, operators can establish Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that build, test, and deploy network configurations across the entire data center with increased speed and reliability.

  • Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills.
  • 5+ Fluency in one of C or C++ programming.

Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share, and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.

To do this, we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6000 citations in scientific papers and over 60000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories, analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes.

Saphetor is a Swiss precision medicine company with offices in Lausanne (CH), Boston (USA), and Athens (GR) employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a C++ Developer to join our backend team. If you're driven by clean code, cross team collaboration and excited to work in the fast moving world of genomics, this is a place where your work will matter.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Code Craftsmanship: Write reusable, testable, and efficient code — backed by thorough unit and regression tests that keep the platform reliable as it evolves.
  • Core Engineering: Develop our core C++ applications and library for importing and analyzing genetic data.
  • Project Ownership: Take complete ownership of projects ranging from a few days to a month, delivering working end-to-end implementations from design through testing and deployment.
  • Performance & Scale: Assist in the optimization and architecture of our platform for maximum speed, high availability, and scalability — pushing the limits of what's possible with large-scale genomic data.
  • Annotation Tooling: Maintain and improve our internal high-performance clinical annotation tools and the custom databases purpose-built and optimized for genetics workloads.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to clear, lasting documentation of software architecture and implementation details so the team can build on.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with backend engineers, bioinformaticians, and product stakeholders to scope work, align on interfaces, and deliver cohesive end-to-end features.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate is a C++ Developer with hands-on experience writing modern C++. You write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable engaging in code reviews and cross-functional work with other stakeholders.

What you will bring:

  • Academic Foundation: BS or MS degree in Computer Science.
  • C++ Expertise: At least 3 years of professional experience as a back-end developer working with C++ (preferably with C++ 17 or later), templates, STL containers, smart pointers, memory management and multithreading.
  • Database Skills: Hands-on experience with relational databases, including optimizing queries and table schemas for peak performance.
  • Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed cloud-based computing and big-data systems.
  • Design Principles: Good grasp of fundamental application design and object-oriented principles, essential for building and maintaining a large, high-quality codebase.
  • Active Engagement: Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Team Player: Flexible mindset, comfortable stepping into a variety of roles as needed.

Strongly Valued:

  • In-Memory & RPC Tech: Experience with in-memory databases like Redis and gRPC services.
  • Domain Interest: Some bioinformatics background — or a genuine willingness to dive into the domain.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote-first work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

Saphetor is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and our employees, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, medical condition or disability, sexual orientation, gender expression, or marital status.

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Greystar is seeking a Platform Engineer to join the Data team. This is a senior, deeply technical platform operations role responsible for the reliability, governance, and cost efficiency of Greystar’s enterprise data infrastructure — a Databricks-native medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) running entirely on Microsoft Azure. You will work within the DataOps pod under the Analytics Engineering umbrella, owning Databricks workspace administration, Unity Catalog governance, Azure infrastructure operations, and multi-system platform support.

This role is platform-engineering-heavy. Most of your day lives inside Databricks workspace administration and the full Azure data services stack: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, Key Vault, Log Analytics, and beyond. You will enforce platform standards, govern identity and access, optimize compute and storage spend, and provide platform support for EDP, DALDW, ADF, Synapse, Cosmos DB, and SQL Server. Deep mastery of Databricks administration and the Azure platform is a baseline expectation.

Databricks Platform Engineering & Administration

Azure Infrastructure & Integration

Multi-Platform Support

• Support compliance, audit readiness, and Key Vault secret rotation and management

CI/CD & Environment Deployments

• Own the full deployment pipeline for DMP data workflows — promoting changes from development through staging to production

• Build and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Enterprise: branch strategies, PR automation, environment-specific configuration management, and release gating

• Enforce deployment standards: automated testing gates, rollback procedures, change documentation, and environment parity controls

• Use Linear for sprint planning, release tracking, and issue management across deployment cycles

Identity, Access & Governance

• Partner with the Data Governance team to enforce data contracts, ownership standards, and quality SLAs within Unity Catalog

• Maintain data lineage, metadata management, and governance framework documentation

• Ensure platform configurations meet security, compliance, and audit requirements

Environment Parity & Dev/Staging/Prod Management

• Own workspace configuration parity across Dev, Staging, and Production Databricks environments — cluster policies, Unity Catalog hierarchy, access controls, and compute configurations

• Define and enforce environment promotion hygiene: configuration drift detection, environment-specific secret management, and pre-production validation gates

• Maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scripts and configuration templates to ensure reproducible, auditable environment provisioning across all tiers

Documentation & Collaboration

• Produce thorough technical documentation: runbooks, deployment playbooks, incident post-mortems, ADRs, and platform specs

• Partner with analytics engineers, data governance, and product stakeholders on platform design and capacity planning

• Participate in on-call rotation and support SLA commitments for business-critical DMP data domains

AI-Driven Platform Observability & Self-Healing Infrastructure

• Build and maintain AI-powered platform observability infrastructure — using LLMs and ML models to detect pipeline drift, classify anomalies, predict SLA risk, and generate automated incident summaries at the platform layer

• Architect and deploy self-healing pipeline capabilities — automated retry logic, circuit breakers, and remediation triggers — as production-grade platform features, not experiments

Data Pipeline Architecture & Platform Standards

• Own DMP pipeline architecture patterns from an infrastructure standpoint — Delta Live Tables (DLT) design standards, schema evolution enforcement, and medallion layer contracts

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

A high-impact role at the center of Greystar’s enterprise data transformation with access to cutting-edge tooling — Databricks, the full Azure stack, GitHub Enterprise, and an active AI innovation agenda. Position: Cloud & FinOps / Azure Architect

We are seeking an experienced Cloud & FinOps / Azure Architect to lead the governance, architecture, security, and cost optimization of our Microsoft Azure environment.

This is a strategic leadership role responsible for designing scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud solutions while overseeing an enterprise Azure estate containing more than 20 years of historical data. You will drive our FinOps strategy, optimize cloud spending, define data lifecycle management, and architect modern Azure data platforms that balance performance, scalability, and cost.

Key Responsibilities

Azure Architecture & Governance

  • Establish and maintain Azure governance standards, policies, and best practices.
  • Review and approve technical designs to ensure architectural consistency, security, and cost efficiency.

FinOps & Cloud Cost Optimization

    • Storage tiers (Hot, Cool, Archive)
    • Compute resources (Reserved Instances, Autoscaling, Shutdown Policies)
    • Backup and disaster recovery strategies
    • Licensing and reserved capacity
  • Partner closely with Finance and business stakeholders to maximize cloud ROI.

Azure Data Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Design tiered Azure storage strategies aligned with business and compliance requirements.
  • Lead data rationalization initiatives by identifying redundant, obsolete, trivial (ROT), and duplicate data.
  • Optimize backup strategies by aligning recovery objectives (RPO/RTO) with business criticality.
  • Implement data compression, partitioning, pruning, and lifecycle policies to reduce long-term storage costs.

Azure Data Platform Architecture

  • Own the architecture of enterprise Azure data platforms, including:
    • Azure Data Lake
    • Azure Databricks
    • Customer Data Platforms (CDP) such as Amperity
    • Integration platforms (iPaaS)
  • Design efficient and scalable data pipelines.
  • Optimize batch and real-time processing workloads.
  • Minimize unnecessary data movement across platforms.
  • Establish reusable data product architectures that reduce duplication across business teams.
  • Ensure effective separation of compute and storage for maximum performance and cost efficiency.

Azure Data Cost Reduction Program

Lead enterprise-wide initiatives to optimize Azure data costs through:

  • Comprehensive assessment of Azure infrastructure and storage utilization.
  • Identification of high-cost storage accounts, redundant backups, and unused datasets.
  • Implementation of storage lifecycle management policies.
  • Archiving cold data and optimizing backup strategies.
  • Redesigning cloud architecture to improve long-term efficiency.
  • Developing real-time cost dashboards and continuous optimization processes.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Microsoft and cloud partners to identify cost optimization opportunities.
  • Evaluate licensing, reserved capacity, and commercial optimization strategies.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Data, Security, and Finance teams to align cloud investments with business priorities.

  • Proven experience leading Azure FinOps or large-scale cloud cost optimization initiatives.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Microsoft Azure

    • Azure Storage and Lifecycle Management

jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

Role Overview

As a Design System Engineer, you’ll be the technical steward of the component library that every product engineer at PermitFlow builds on top of. You'll work at the intersection of design and engineering, partnering closely with our Design Systems lead to define and ship the atoms, molecules, and organisms that keep our product consistent, fast to build, and delightful to use.

This isn't a supporting role. You'll set the standards, own the roadmap, review PRs into the library, and be the go-to person when teams hit the edges of what our design system supports. You'll also lead the federated model we've established — working with team champions across our product squads to drive adoption, surface gaps, and maintain quality across a fast-moving codebase.

What You'll Do

  • Own the day-to-day development and evolution of PermitFlow's React component library

  • Build and maintain components across all levels of the Atomic Design hierarchy — atoms, molecules, organisms, and templates — ensuring each is robust, accessible, and documented in Storybook

  • Define and enforce component standards: API contracts, design token usage, prop interfaces, and variant patterns

  • Review PRs into the component library, maintaining quality bar and ensuring consistency

  • Partner with designers using Figma to translate design specs into production-grade components with fidelity

  • Manage the library's roadmap, balancing new component development with migration work as we bring the broader application into alignment

  • Work with Chromatic for visual regression testing and manage the Storybook instance as the source of truth for component documentation

  • Lead the Design Systems Guild — a cross-team working group of engineering champions — sharing updates, aligning on patterns, and reviewing proposals before implementation

  • Reduce overall frontend complexity: our migration work has already yielded thousands of lines of consolidation, and there's more to go

What We're Looking For

  • Strong React and TypeScript fundamentals — you think in components, not just in pages

  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining a production design system or component library, not just consuming one — a portfolio, GitHub profile, or Storybook instance you can share carries more weight than a resume line

  • A sharp eye for visual and interaction design — you notice when something is off and can articulate why clearly

  • Experience working in close partnership with product designers: giving and receiving feedback on specs, negotiating tradeoffs, and aligning on the right abstraction before something gets built

  • Familiarity with design tooling (Figma) and developer experience tooling (Storybook, Chromatic, or equivalents)

  • Strong written communication — you'll be setting standards that product engineers read and follow, and documenting decisions that outlast you

  • Experience with Tailwind CSS is a strong plus

  • Experience with ShadCN or Radix UI primitives is a strong plus

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) is a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Highlights:
